source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1952, p. 5 ("County and rural council elections: results"); Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations"); Irish News, 6 June 1952, p. 3 ("Coleraine Rural District results")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: BNL 6 Jun 1952 p5 results, read in the block image: Morell 284, Walmsley 97; INW 6 Jun 1952 p3 the same, majority 187.

note: Triennial election of the 21 electoral divisions of Coleraine rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Nineteen retiring members were returned unopposed; Garvagh and Articlave were contested and both sitting members held their seats. H. Morrell, the outgoing member (spelt Morell in the BNL results, Morrell in the nominations), defeated William A. Walmsley. Walmsley's vote is 97 (image and Irish News; majority 187); the record had 87. No party label was printed.
